title: POS service down: registers cannot scan or sell
body: Run the pos_service and ping checks. If pos_service is stopped, L2 restarts it from the store server console, then confirms a test scan. If it stops again, check for a recent patch.

title: New item missing at store or price missing after setup
body: Run the item_file_age_hours check. If the last item file is older than 24h, the file did not reach the store: re-send it. If it is fresh, the item was not in the file: check the item setup record.

title: Shelf label or register shows wrong price
body: Look up the item price in the pricing system and at the store. If the pricing system is right, push a price update to the store. If the pricing system is wrong, send to the pricing team.

title: Batch job BATCH01 hung
body: Run the batch_jobs check. If BATCH01 is hung, restart the job. Restart is safe and idempotent.

title: Void an advance shipping notice (ASN)
body: Look up the ASN. Only an ASN that has not been received can be voided (status 9). A received ASN needs L2 to reverse the receipt first.
